profile.name: John Smith
profile.headline: Senior Frontend Engineer | React, TypeScript, Next.js | Data Visualisation
summary: Senior frontend engineer with 10 years of experience building web applications, focused on React and TypeScript since 2017. I specialise in data-heavy products: analytics dashboards, interactive charts and internal tools that turn large datasets into decisions, including a retail insights platform used by 40+ client teams.

I work closely with designers, product managers and backend engineers, and care about accessible, fast interfaces. In my daily work I use AI-assisted development (Cursor, ChatGPT) and automated testing, which helps ship features 20–30% faster without lowering code quality.

experience.blurb: Product company building analytics software for retail chains; part of the team responsible for the customer-facing dashboard and internal data tooling.

projects.name: Insight Dashboard
bullets: Rebuilt the main reporting dashboard in React and TypeScript, with configurable widgets and saved views for each client team
Introduced virtualised tables and chart sampling, cutting load time of the largest reports from 9 to 2 seconds
Used AI-assisted coding (Cursor) for test scaffolding and refactors, keeping test coverage above 85%

projects.name: Labelling Studio
bullets: Built a browser tool for labelling product images and descriptions used to train recommendation models
Added real-time collaboration over WebSockets so several reviewers could work on one dataset at once
Designed quality reports showing agreement between reviewers, which reduced relabelling work by 25%

experience.blurb: Small web projects for local businesses, delivered alongside full-time work.
bullets: Delivered landing pages, booking flows and small online shops, from first sketch to deployment and handover

projects.name: Harbour Health
projects.client: booking system for a physiotherapy clinic
bullets: Built online appointment booking with reminders, replacing phone-only bookings for three clinic locations
Reached a Lighthouse accessibility score of 100 on all public pages

projects.name: Pedal and Co.
projects.client: online shop for a bike workshop
bullets: Created a small e-commerce site with a product catalogue, stock levels and a simple admin panel for the owners
Developed features for a project-management web app used by around 2,000 teams
Migrated the main application from jQuery to React, page by page, without a feature freeze
Built and maintained marketing websites and email templates for agency clients
